assertions: TaskNF91KY in-progress genuine EditEngine item-pool prerequisite: original SvxNumRule ten-slot storage,source Writer/Draw initial geometry,feature/continuous flags,Get versus GetLevel,reference and pointer SetLevel ordering,copy/assignment,active-count equality,SvxNodeNum fixed storage,SvxNumBulletItem owned rule and SvxConvertNumRule. Existing shared SvxNumberFormat remains the actual value dependency,not a substitute numbering facade;its unrepresented fields/services still require canonical porting. Original numdef constants have one shared owner. Native static cleanup is erased under GC. Original SetLevel/convert validity asymmetries remain(CALC243). Full stream/number-string/graphic/UNO wrapper,complete EditEngine pool/rich-text owner and Calc style/UI/layout remain unported;no broad parity promotion.

This same prerequisite adds original NumberFormat alignment,relative bullet size(min25 after unsigned16 conversion),stable owned Color,character-style and legal flag to defaults/copy/equality. Original GetDefaultFonts updates actual three-script items in order for LATIN_TEXT/en-US,CJK_TEXT/en-US,CTL_TEXT/ar-SA through existing genuine no-device VCL metadata. VCL now preserves the original UI-font fallback when a configured role is empty and NONE versus OnlyOne candidate selection;unknown roles retain source fallback rather than an invented exception. The original fixed language ID and GetDefaultFontFlags bits are represented. Actual configured-tag temporary ownership is released. No config provider,output device,renderer,thread service or generic numbering/UNO facade is fabricated.

TaskNF91KY preserves nonvirtual SvxNumberFormat base assignment/comparison over stored represented fields,including the base stored style name behind Writer virtual GetCharFormatName. SvxNumRule.SetLevel explicitly binds base comparison when passed a genuine SwNumFormat,then slices an owned base copy. Actual SwNumFormat now implements its original virtual name query through the registered actual SwFormat base GetName read site;no SwCharFormat owner or name-provider facade is fabricated. Tests initialize the real composed SwClient member against a real SwFormat to verify registration,name changes,copy and base-field distinctions. Full SwCharFormat and broader missing native fields/services remain unported.

stackDivergence.rationale: Actual shared native value classes retain source storage and ordering;SetLevelPointer is an explicit binding of the native pointer overload. No numbering service or pool facade is introduced.
